meta.source: Public Mads Instagram posts, Apify extract 2026-10-27, downloaded original source media
meta.notice: Independent concept preview using 33 curated original Instagram post photographs now stored under assets/creations. All 33 source post links matched to Apify export; captions informed descriptions; occasion classification is proposed and subject to owner approval.

Photo and product descriptions grounded in original post captions; Valentine hero uses the full-cake third carousel photo.
